No longer able to read the Heliosgyre after his mind was corrupted by Voidmatter, he serves the Solisylum by collecting data from the outside world now. |voiceEN = |voiceCN = |voiceJP = |voiceKR = }} {{Quote|His breath carries a strange chill..}} '''The Chronicler''' is one of the [[Heliodic Six]] members and makes his first appearance in [[Ode to the Second Sunrise]]. After completing {{Quest|Ode to the Second Sunrise}}, The Chronicler is found near TIN & CAN eatery at {{color|help|06:00 to 17:00}}. ==Location== Heliodic Six Location - The Chronicler.png ==Quests and Events== * [[Ode to the Second Sunrise]] {{Quests and Events}} {{Dialogue Start}} ==Dialogue== :;The seat turnover rate... :'''The Chronicler:''' During the peak dining hours, seat turnover rises by 37%, yet the average meal time falls by 15%. Such herd behavior is worth chronicling. :{{DIcon}} Excuse me, are you one of the Heliodic Six? :'''The Chronicler:''' Greetings, Arbiter from the chronicles. I am Eivind the Chronicler. For your aid in the Solisylum, our deep gratitude you have. :'''The Chronicler:''' Since the Spacetrek Collective launched Helios, the Heliogyre is no longer our sole observational tool. From pure computation, we are freed. Our attention may turn to other significant realms. :{{DIcon}} What brings you here? :'''The Chronicler:''' Research. For Roya under the new sun, new Lahai-Roi season laws are required. Local diets, their social rhythms... Yes, all precious first-hand data. :'''The Chronicler:''' Look at those mingling at shared tables. Their conversations, food preferences, and even body language... they paint a portrait of present society. :'''The Chronicler:''' Subtle data, this. For the Heliogyre to quantify, difficult. But important to the drafting of new season laws and their guiding procedures. :'''The Chronicler:''' As Chronicler, I will report my thoughts and observations back to the Shaper. Such services can still be of use to him. {{Dialogue End}} ==Character Mentions== {{Character Mentions}} ==Other Languages== {{Other Languages |1_en = The Chronicler |1_zhs = 归律 |1_zht = 歸律 |1_ja = 刻む者 |1_ko = 귀율(the Chronicler) |1_fr = Le Chroniqueur |1_de = Der Chronist |1_es = El Cronista |1_th = ผู้ประมวลกฎ |2_en = Eivind |2_zhs = |2_zht = |2_ja = |2_ko = |2_fr = |2_de = |2_es = |2_th = }} ==Change History== {{Change History|3.0}}
